spans.s:
m. (-णः)
1 A corner, an angle.
2 The quill or bow of a lute, a fiddle stick, &c.
3 A drum stick.
4 A sort of stringed musical instrument.
5 The sharp edge of a sword.
6 A stick, a staff, a club.
7 A name of Maṅgala, the planet

An intermediate point of the compass.
E.
कुण to sound, &c. घञ् aff.

m. (-णः)
A bug.
E.
कुण to cut, affix क, added to कोण the edge of a sword.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Having a crooked arm: see कुणि.
